title: Elisha, Master of Wings
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: A very pious man. Shabbat 49a relates that once a decree ordered the brain of anyone wearing tefillin to be pierced. Elisha nevertheless wore them into the marketplace. A royal officer found him and asked, “What is in your hand?” He answered, “A dove’s wings,” and so they proved to be. He was therefore called Master of Wings. Hyman infers from the incident that he lived in the Tannaitic period.

notes.text: שפ״א means that once in this sentence, not in an evil time. The account of wings and the chronological inference remain the notice’s report.
